lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਇਉ ਮਾਂਨਈ ਹੋਇ ਗਈ ਭਠ ਛਾਰ ॥੧੯੫॥
lines.transliteration: bin sa(n)gat iu maa(n)naee hoi gaee bhath chhaar ||195||
lines.translation: You must acknowledge this, that without the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, it turns into burnt ashes. ||195||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬੂੰਦ ਅਕਾਸ ਕੀ ਲੀਨੀ ਭੂਮਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer niramal boo(n)d akaas kee leenee bhoom milaai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the pure drop of water falls from the sky, and mixes with the dust.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਸਿਆਨੇ ਪਚਿ ਗਏ ਨਾ ਨਿਰਵਾਰੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੯੬॥
lines.transliteration: anik siaane pach gae naa niravaaree jaai ||196||
lines.translation: Millions of clever people may try, but they will fail - it cannot be made separate again. ||196||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹਜ ਕਾਬੇ ਹਉ ਜਾਇ ਥਾ ਆਗੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer haj kaabe hau jaai thaa aagai miliaa khudaai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, I was going on a pilgrimage to Mecca, and God met me on the way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਈ ਮੁਝ ਸਿਉ ਲਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ ਤੁਝੈ ਕਿਨੑਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ਗਾਇ ॥੧੯੭॥
lines.transliteration: saa(n)ee mujh siu lar pariaa tujhai kinhi phuramaaee gaai ||197||
lines.translation: He scolded me and asked, "Who told you that I am only there?" ||197||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹਜ ਕਾਬੈ ਹੋਇ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਆ ਕੇਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਕਬੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer haj kaabai hoi hoi gaiaa ketee baar kabeer ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, I went to Mecca - how many times, Kabeer?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਈ ਮੁਝ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਖਤਾ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਨ ਬੋਲੈ ਪੀਰ ॥੧੯੮॥
lines.transliteration: saa(n)ee mujh mahi kiaa khataa mukhahu na bolai peer ||198||
lines.translation: O Lord, what is the problem with me? You have not spoken to me with Your Mouth. ||198||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਅ ਜੁ ਮਾਰਹਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਹਤੇ ਹਹਿ ਜੁ ਹਲਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer jee j maarahi jor kar kahate hahi j halaal ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, they oppress living beings and kill them, and call it proper.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਫਤਰੁ ਦਈ ਜਬ ਕਾਢਿ ਹੈ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਕਉਨੁ ਹਵਾਲੁ ॥੧੯੯॥
lines.transliteration: daphatar daee jab kaadh hai hoigaa kaun havaal ||199||
lines.translation: When the Lord calls for their account, what will their condition be? ||199||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੋਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਜੁਲਮੁ ਹੈ ਲੇਇ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer jor keeaa so julam hai lei jabaab khudaai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, it is tyranny to use force; the Lord shall call you to account.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਫਤਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਨੀਕਸੈ ਮਾਰ ਮੁਹੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਖਾਇ ॥੨੦੦॥
lines.transliteration: daphatar lekhaa neekasai maar muhai muhi khaai ||200||
lines.translation: When your account is called for, your face and mouth shall be beaten. ||200||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਨਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜਉ ਦਿਲ ਸੂਚੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer lekhaa denaa suhelaa jau dil soochee hoi ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, it is easy to render your account, if your heart is pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਸੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਦੀਬਾਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਲਾ ਨ ਪਕਰੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨੦੧॥
lines.transliteration: us saache deebaan mahi palaa na pakarai koi ||201||
lines.translation: In the True Court of the Lord, no one will seize you. ||201||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਧਰਤੀ ਅਰੁ ਆਕਾਸ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਇ ਤੂੰ ਬਰੀ ਅਬਧ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer dharatee ar aakaas mahi dui too(n) baree abadh ||
lines.translation: Kabeer: O duality, you are mighty and powerful in the earth and the sky.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੰਸੇ ਪਰੇ ਅਰੁ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਸਿਧ ॥੨੦੨॥
lines.transliteration: khat darasan sa(n)se pare ar chauraaseeh sidh ||202||
lines.translation: The six Shaastras and the eighty-four Siddhas are entrenched in skepticism. ||202||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੁਝ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਸੋ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer meraa mujh mahi kichh nahee jo kichh hai so teraa ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, nothing is mine within myself. Whatever there is, is Yours, O Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਤੁਝ ਕਉ ਸਉਪਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੨੦੩॥
lines.transliteration: teraa tujh kau saupate kiaa laagai meraa ||203||
lines.translation: If I surrender to You what is already Yours, what does it cost me? ||203||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਤੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੂ ਹੂਆ ਮੁਝ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਾ ਨ ਹੂੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer too(n) too(n) karataa too hooaa mujh mahi rahaa na hoo(n) ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, repeating, "You, You", I have become like You. Nothing of me remains in myself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਆਪਾ ਪਰ ਕਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਤੂ ॥੨੦੪॥
lines.transliteration: jab aapaa par kaa mit gaiaa jat dekhau tat too ||204||
lines.translation: When the difference between myself and others is removed, then wherever I look, I see only You. ||204||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਬਿਕਾਰਹ ਚਿਤਵਤੇ ਝੂਠੇ ਕਰਤੇ ਆਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer bikaarah chitavate jhoothe karate aas ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, those who think of evil and entertain false hopes

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੋਰਥੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪੂਰਿਓ ਚਾਲੇ ਊਠਿ ਨਿਰਾਸ ॥੨੦੫॥
lines.transliteration: manorath koi na poorio chaale ooth niraas ||205||
lines.translation: - none of their desires shall be fulfilled; they shall depart in despair. ||205||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer har kaa simaran jo karai so sukheeaa sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, whoever meditates in remembrance on the Lord, he alone is happy in this world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਡੋਲਈ ਜਿਸ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰ ॥੨੦੬॥
lines.transliteration: it ut katahi na dolaee jis raakhai sirajanahaar ||206||
lines.translation: One who is protected and saved by the Creator Lord, shall never waver, here or hereafter. ||206||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਘਾਣੀ ਪੀੜਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲੀਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer ghaanee peeRate satigur leee chhadaai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, I was being crushed like sesame seeds in the oil-press, but the True Guru saved me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਲੀ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ਆਇ ॥੨੦੭॥
lines.transliteration: paraa poorabalee bhaavanee paragat hoee aai ||207||
lines.translation: My pre-ordained primal destiny has now been revealed. ||207||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਟਾਲੈ ਟੋਲੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਗਇਆ ਬਿਆਜੁ ਬਢੰਤਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer taalai tolai din gaiaa biaaj badha(n)tau jaai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, my days have passed, and I have postponed my payments; the interest on my account continues to increase.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਿਓ ਨ ਖਤੁ ਫਟਿਓ ਕਾਲੁ ਪਹੂੰਚੋ ਆਇ ॥੨੦੮॥
lines.transliteration: naa har bhajio na khat phatio kaal pahoo(n)cho aai ||208||
lines.translation: I have not meditated on the Lord and my account is still pending, and now, the moment of my death has come! ||208||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕੂਕਰੁ ਭਉਕਨਾ ਕਰੰਗ ਪਿਛੈ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer kookar bhaukanaa kara(n)g pichhai uth dhaai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the mortal is a barking dog, chasing after a carcass.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਉ ਲੀਆ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੨੦੯॥
lines.transliteration: karamee satigur paaiaa jin hau leeaa chhadaai ||209||
lines.translation: By the Grace of good karma, I have found the True Guru, who has saved me. ||209||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਤਸਕਰ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਗਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer dharatee saadh kee tasakar baisahi gaahi ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the earth belongs to the Holy, but it is being occupied by thieves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਭਾਰਿ ਨ ਬਿਆਪਈ ਉਨ ਕਉ ਲਾਹੂ ਲਾਹਿ ॥੨੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: dharatee bhaar na biaapaee un kau laahoo laahi ||210||
lines.translation: They are not a burden to the earth; they receive its blessings. ||210||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਚਾਵਲ ਕਾਰਨੇ ਤੁਖ ਕਉ ਮੁਹਲੀ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer chaaval kaarane tukh kau muhalee laai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the rice is beaten with a mallet to get rid of the husk.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਕੁਸੰਗੀ ਬੈਸਤੇ ਤਬ ਪੂਛੈ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ॥੨੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)g kusa(n)gee baisate tab poochhai dharam raai ||211||
lines.translation: When people sit in evil company, the Righteous Judge of Dharma calls them to account. ||211||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਕਹੈ ਤਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: naamaa maaiaa mohiaa kahai tilochan meet ||
lines.translation: Trilochan says, O Naam Dayv, Maya has enticed you, my friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਹੇ ਛੀਪਹੁ ਛਾਇਲੈ ਰਾਮ ਨ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥੨੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaahe chheepahu chhaailai raam na laavahu cheet ||212||
lines.translation: Why are you printing designs on these sheets, and not focusing your consciousness on the Lord? ||212||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਾ ਕਹੈ ਤਿਲੋਚਨਾ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਸੰਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naamaa kahai tilochanaa mukh te raam sa(n)mhaal ||
lines.translation: Naam Dayv answers, O Trilochan, chant the Lord's Name with your mouth.
